_notes: Filter Manager naming settings (not shown in the UI). Save as UTF-8.
operator_symbols changes only the {rules} token in Rename Filters proposals.
Manager summaries and search keep the readable wording.
Remove a key to use the readable wording for that operator.
Every value is checked with Revit NamingUtils.IsValidName. An invalid file disables pattern rename with an error.
Revit rejects ASCII < > ~ : ; | [ ] { } \ ? ` in names; the fullwidth characters below are accepted instead.
Operators wrapped by a native NOT rule render as 'NOT ' followed by the base operator text.
